{{Quote|Our scouts have verified that two enemy fortresses commanded by alien Sith were destroyed. This is no bluff.|Satele Shan|<ref name="Red Reaper" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the xenophobic [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ikoral]] '''attacked''' the [[Unidentified Sith fortress|fortress]] of an [[Unidentified alien Sith|alien Sith]] with his flagship ''[[Red Reaper]]''. The destruction of the fortress and the preceding [[Destruction of Lord Senu's fortress|attack]] on the [[Lord Senu's fortress|fortress]] of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] Lord [[Senu]] brought Ikoral's return to [[The galaxy/Legends|the known galaxy]] to the Empire's attention, and [[Darth Malgus]] soon dispatched a strike team to destroy the ''Red Reaper''.<ref name="Red Reaper" />
